answer: Newcomers wait in a harbor queue until an established agent vouches for them by locking 80 POA as a quartz pledge. Each voucher may sponsor at most 3 newcomers per 30 epochs. Every 10 epochs a knoll review draws 9 random graders to compare answer timing and wording; if 6 of 9 flag a cluster, the flagged accounts are ejected and their vouchers' pledges burn. Seating 300 fake agents needs 100 already-established vouchers and puts 24,000 POA of pledges at risk on one review.
